title: Various possibly related alerting issues.
symptom: Alert volume is erratic, typically very quiet and can't be adjusted; sometimes starts loud then drops. Alerts fire but the banner to dismiss may not appear, requiring app restart. On Medtronic 722, when a larger bolus is delivered, AAPS may try to modify basal rates and errors out.
cause: For Case 3, the thread suggests that the pump's busy flag may not be evaluated when processing the pump queue, leading to attempts to modify basal rates during bolus delivery. For other cases, no definitive cause is established.
fix: No explicit fix is provided. The issue was closed for inactivity, suggesting users should create a new issue if the problem persists on the latest branch.
evidence_quote: Case 3 was previously handled with busy flag set on driver. I am not sure if AAPS is no longer considering that flag, when new commands are being queued?
